meti_parks.survey: 経済産業省 特定サービス産業動態統計調査（政府統計コード 00550050）業種13 遊園地・テーマパーク
meti_parks.sample_definition: 調査単位=事業所, 調査範囲=全国. 調査対象は調査業種の全国年間売上高の概ね70%をカバーする売上高上位の事業所 (調査の概要2024年1月分). NOT a census of all parks; levels are sample totals.
meti_parks.number_of_facilities_note: Missing: the number of sampled 事業所 for 遊園地・テーマパーク is not stated in the 調査の概要 (2024) nor in the long-term table; METI's own tokusabido pages (www.meti.go.jp) returned HTTP 403 (CloudFront) for every URL incl. the top page, so METI-hosted documents could not be checked.
discontinuities: 注１: 2015年1月分より調査対象の見直し → 2014/2015 break in levels.
注２: 2002年1月分, 2006年1月分 一部調査対象の追加等 → breaks.
注３: 2012年1月分, 2016年1月分, 2017年4月分, 2022年1月分, 2023年1月分, 2024年6月分 一部数値に変更 → breaks.

Survey ended with 2024年12月分 (last update 2025-03-19); from 2025 METI's tokusabido was folded into the MIC サービス産業動態統計調査 (00200546) which does not carry park visitor counts in the same form (not verified here).

link_coefficients.how_to_use: To splice: divide values BEFORE the break month by the coefficient (per METI note for 2024: 「２０２４年５月以前の数値を使う場合は、以下の「リンク係数」で除してください」).

2023-01.note: other items in 2023 sheet not parsed cleanly (complex layout); check source

derived_seasonality_visitor_share_2015_2.note: Derived by this collector: mean over 2015-2019 of (month visitors / calendar-year visitors). Not an official statistic.

meti_parks.note: Sample (top ~70% of national sales) of amusement parks/theme parks; TDR/USJ-scale parks are presumably inside the sample but individual parks are not identifiable. COVID: 2020-2022 heavily depressed (closures Mar-Jun 2020, capacity caps 2020-2022).

notes: OLC (www.olc.co.jp): blocked (empty reply after TLS). TDR fiscal-year attendance 1983-2025, quarterly attendance, per-guest spend series and ゲストプロフィール could NOT be collected; only a few secondary citations included.
METI pages on www.meti.go.jp: HTTP 403 from CloudFront on every URL incl. homepage; METI data obtained instead from e-Stat (official government portal, same tables).
TEA/AECOM figures are estimates (TEA notes many operators, incl. OLC for the TDL/TDS split, do not publish park-level numbers). Calendar-year basis, unlike OLC fiscal year (Apr-Mar).

TEA 2024 and 2025 editions (Global Experience Index) are only offered via a registration form on teaconnect.org; not submitted. 2023 edition link on TEA site points to acrobat.adobe.com (not allowed); AECOM copy used.
COVID: 2020-2022 values are depressed by closures (TDR closed 2020-02-29 to 2020-06-30) and capacity limits; treat as structural breaks for seasonality/trend estimation.
TEA 2022/2023 tables are in thousands; converted. TEA restated some prior-year values (2011 TDL/TDS/Hakkeijima/Summerland) - see restated_in_next_report.

Coordinates are approximate public locations from general knowledge (一般に知られている所在地), not geocoded from an authoritative source in this run. Opening dates are general knowledge, not verified against a fetched source.

Day-of-week / weather effects: no J-STAGE paper found that quantifies them for Japanese theme parks. 林田・渡辺(1995) (js_expo1995) decomposes daily expo attendance (Census X-11) and finds small day-of-week variation for large international expos but extremely high Sundays for small regional expos (qualitative extraction only; text layer poor). 市川ら(2024) (js_sar2024) estimates theme-park visitors from SAR parking-lot imagery (no coefficients extracted).
No J-STAGE/official source found giving TDR or USJ visitor shares by origin prefecture/distance.
